title: How to Progress Faster in Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker
subtitle: Energy, artifacts, research and managers, in order.
description: How to progress faster in Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker, power plants, energy modes, the Mining Rig, the Lab and managers explained in the order to use them.
card: Which systems to use first to speed up Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker, energy modes, the Mining Rig, research and managers.

faq.a: Keep buying upgrades with all your coins, then use your energy modes and slot your best artifacts. After your first prestige, spend Research Points in the Lab and hire managers before you prestige again.

faq.q: How do I get Research Points?
faq.a: You earn 4 Research Points per prestige and 30 per Ascension, plus a small daily trickle. The Lab unlocks after your first prestige and has 28 upgrades across four branches.

faq.q: Do managers keep working after a prestige?
faq.a: Yes. You can hire up to six managers, including foremen, a tap coach, an engineer and a steward. They level up with coins and keep working through prestige and ascension.
